annotations.title: Find the source of a quotation (alpha)

description:
Finds where a quoted passage comes from (paste the quotation alone, ≤ 3,000 characters, original language). Check each result against the source (link provided). Returns texts and decisions containing it, with a match % (100 = word for word, ignoring punctuation, case, accents) and word differences. Statuses: trouve; trouve_avec_differences; non_trouve (database may be incomplete); trop_court; trop_courant; indetermine (sources timed out: retry). `textes_d_origine` = statutory sources; `repris_dans` = decisions quoting it; otherwise `decisions`, oldest first. Covers codes and statutes (`version_du`), JO, collective agreements, all French case law, ECHR, CJEU, CNIL, doctrine, professional codes, EU acts in force (`note_textes_europeens`). Article references in the text are listed, unchecked, with their get_law_article call.

Example: check_citations(text="Les obligations naissent d'actes juridiques, de faits juridiques ou de l'autorité seule de la loi.")

text.description: the quotation alone (a sentence or a paragraph), 3,000 characters at most.
